review_id: review sequence number; R for the initial batch, Q for the machine core candidate queue
human_transcription_latex: formula LaTeX checked symbol by symbol against the page
human_m_labels: label list verified against the M01–M12 rules
human_m_node_witness: optional: human-identified M-label node witness; present only on some records
machine_record_fully_matches_gold: machine OCR, tree, labels and core status all agree with the human review
source_pdf_sha256: SHA-256 of the source PDF; the source PDF is not distributed
gold_accepted: whether the record is included in the Gold submission set
frozen_version_review_outcome: review outcome of the frozen version (accepted)
review_cohort: review batch through which the record entered Gold
